finding: During ATM-GOV-0195, a continuation prompt that mentioned the external 3KLife plan path was blocked as active-task divergence even though the operator intent was to continue the active task.
expectedBehavior: When an active task has planningMirrorPaths or planningReadOnlyPaths matching the mentioned external plan, next should either recognize it as same-task context or provide a concise continuation command that preserves the active task without treating the planning path as foreign scope.
evidenceOrRepro: The historical failure is fixed by making active-task divergence planning-root aware. The prompt path extractor may retain only a repository-relative `docs/...` fragment from an absolute Windows path; the router now compares both canonical absolute planning paths and paths relative to the task's planning repository. `node --strip-types tests/cli/active-task-planning-root-continuation.test.ts` passes: a prompt naming the active task's external plan is accepted as continuation context, while an unrelated plan remains blocked. `node --strip-types tests/cli/autonomous-task-continuation.test.ts` and `npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` also pass.
followUp: Retain the planning-root continuation regression. Reopen only if a new supported planning-path form bypasses same-task recognition.
